change_requests.title: Establish the repository-local private difficult-media corpus directory and publication guard
change_requests.notes: The repository-root WZSN-PRIVATE-TEST-MEDIA directory convention was documented and Git was configured to publish only its README and .gitignore on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Freeze the project workflow rule that no project artifact may be created above the project directory
change_requests.notes: WORKFLOW.md now requires all project artifacts, including private local-only artifacts, to remain within the project directory on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Enforce remote-only build and test execution with private test-artefacts storage
change_requests.notes: Local build/test instructions were removed, the public remote harness contract was added under test-artefacts/README.md, Git was configured to keep all other test-artefacts private, and repository gates now reject local build/test output directories and non-remote CI build/test commands on 2026-08-09.

change_requests.title: Require parser-first validation before any local or remote Windows PowerShell command
change_requests.notes: The tracked helper tools/Test-PowerShellSyntax.ps1 was added, workflow docs now require parser-first validation for local and remote Windows PowerShell commands, and repository gates now require that public rule surface on 2026-08-09.
